rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Talos provides MCP access to Talos Linux cluster management through the native gRPC API. Read-only tools cover resources, services, logs, and health checks, while mutating tools handle service management, reboots, and upgrades. RBAC controls access to sensitive operations, and the server ships with mTLS credentials support and SLSA L2 provenance. Targets Talos Linux v1.9.0 through v1.12.x.
